title: Sprouts Farmers Market Opens at Dalewood
summary: Watch Sprouts Farmers Market Opens and explore more insights from Brixmor on retail, redevelopment, and community. Check out the latest from our blog.
body_markdown:
Fresh food, healthier choices and a growing list of sought-after retailers are coming together at Dalewood Shopping Center.


Sprouts Farmers Market recently celebrated the grand opening of its first Westchester County store and second New York location at Dalewood Shopping Center. The specialty grocer brings fresh produce, natural and organic foods, and a wellness-focused shopping experience to one of the region's premier retail destinations.


The opening marks another milestone in Dalewood's ongoing transformation, building on recent additions including Best Buy, Shake Shack, Ulta Beauty, H Mart, Barnes & Noble and J.Crew Factory.


The addition of Sprouts is another example of how we're creating vibrant shopping destinations where retailers and communities connect and thrive.
